description: For relatives: mark a wish as "I'll give this" so nobody else buys it. Returns a reservation_token; keep it to undo with release_wish. Needs the share link.

name.description: Optional name of who gets the gift, e.g. "Oma Rosi". Shown to parents and family.

share_link.description: The share link (https://wunschzettel.mapumi.de/z/…) or just its id.

title: Reserve a wish
